## Example

```qml
ProgressBar {
    id: bar
    indeterminate: false
    value: 0.6
}
```

## API

Style-only control: no extra QWinUI3 properties. Use the Qt Quick Controls `ProgressBar` API (this file only supplies Fluent visuals / metrics).
